title: Can I BEAT Anarchy Chess?
summary: Anarchy Chess website (based on r/AnarchyChess): 10x10 board with meme pieces and rules — underage pawn (must be captured if seen by a bishop), nuclear fusion (knight + rook landing on one square spawn a 'knook'), long passant (chained en passant captures), pawn throwing (a pawn can be thrown off an adjacent piece to one of three squares; thrown pawn is stunned 1 move), anti-queen (moves to any square a queen can't), plus horse/knight renames. Tony plays the 'Anarchy bot' and wins; the bot replies with a famous GM cheating-rant copypasta.
rules: Underage pawn: must be captured if a bishop can see it.
Nuclear fusion: knight and rook moving onto the same square merge into a knook (rook+knight moves).
Long passant: en passant captures can be chained.
Pawn throwing: a pawn can be thrown by a piece behind it to one of three highlighted landing squares; the thrown pawn is stunned for one move.
Anti-queen: moves to any square a queen could NOT reach.
Other r/AnarchyChess rules flashed on screen (full list not captured).
